# 💬 Support Response Template

## Acknowledgement
Confirm receipt without promising an unverified resolution time.

## Clarifying details
Ask for route, timestamp/timezone, browser, steps to reproduce and sanitized error text. Never request passwords, session cookies or payment credentials.

## Troubleshooting performed
List safe steps and observed outcomes.

## Resolution or escalation
Explain the confirmed fix or the next responsible team.

## Closure
Summarize outcome and link a public documentation page where appropriate.
